statement: For a rank-p GP with supplied features bounded by R, independent observation-noise variance s>0, and labels bounded by B, normalized bidirectional ReLU attention approximates the noisy posterior predictive uniformly in forward KL <= eps. Width 7p+4, at most five heads, depth T+2 where kappa=1+max(1,n)R^2/s, M=nR^2B/s, delta=min(1/2,s/(2R^2),sqrt(s eps)/(1+M),s sqrt(eps)/R^2), T=ceil(sqrt(kappa) log(2/delta)/2). R=0 has an exact constant output.
assumptions: zero-mean GP kernel k(x,xprime)=z(x)^T z(xprime), ||z||<=R
feature vectors supplied as role-encoded tokens; cost of computing arbitrary z from raw x excluded
noisy predictive output, not latent posterior
bidirectional normalized ReLU attention, no layer norm, fixed zero padding to n+1 tokens, arbitrary real weights

Unlike C002, feature computation is counted. The constants, grid size, width, heads, hidden width, and depth are explicit in C004 Sections 1-5.

residual normalized ReLU attention with tokenwise residual ReLU MLPs; no layer normalization or softmax

statement: Every continuous real symmetric PSD kernel of rank <=p and diagonal <=R^2 on a nonempty compact X subset R^d admits an explicit raw-input normalized-ReLU-attention transformer for uniform noisy predictive forward KL <=eps, with positive noise s, labels bounded by B, and contexts <=n. The complete width/depth/MLP/head bound is given in C005 Section 1 in terms of the canonical kernel modulus Omega(r), a finite h-net cardinality J, and the solver constants. A fixed finite Gram factorization supplies all encoder feature values; no feature computation is hidden outside the count.
